messages:
maia: heads up — i've opened a docs PR adding Orion-13B to the model catalog and correcting the context window for aurora variants. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123 :point_up:

ryan: nice, thx. can you also add a quick streaming throughput row? product asked for numbers for the performance page. :eyes:

maia: added a 'streaming throughput' column in the PR diff. quick run on dedicated 8xA100: 260 req/s at 512 tokens, ~92 req/s at 2k (p95 latency ~420ms). raw csv attached in the PR.

ben: small thing — the compatibility_matrix.md link in the new card 404s for me. tried clicking from the preview.

maia: ah, thanks — i accidentally renamed a heading while moving sections. fixing the link in a follow-up commit now.

chandra: tiny SDK nit: the python snippet in the card uses `client.generate(model='orion-13b', ...)` but our examples last quarter started using `model` vs `model_id` inconsistently. which one do we want in docs?

maia: we standardized on `model` in the SDK (breaking compat note was in the migration guide). i'll update the snippet to `model`. can someone paste an idiomatic python + curl example for the card?

ryan: python snippet you can copy:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model='orion-13b', prompt='Tell me a joke', max_tokens=120, stream=False)
print(resp.text)
```

curl example for the inline card snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"orion-13b","prompt":"hi","max_tokens":64}'
```

marta: wording nit: can we change `max_context` to `maximum context length (tokens)` in the card? it's clearer for non-ML readers.

maia: good call, marta — updating phrasing. one more question: should Orion be flagged as `experimental` in the catalog until we validate it on long sequences? i don't want it to show up in default model overrides.

ryan: +1 on experimental flag until we finish long-seq QA. ops: we'll canary the catalog change after the merge.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for 2026-04-02T16:00Z — catalog changes only.

maia: updated the PR with the fixed link, SDK snippets, and the experimental flag. final review? :pray:

ben: LGTM from me. left one inline about Content-Type header consistency in the curl example.

maia: thanks all — PR merged: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4123/merge. i'll open a follow-up for expanded long-sequence benchmarks and tokenizer padding guidance.
